blocking_defects.defect: In A's menu-tap and pay-mark views (opening-a s3-shot-2, 19.05 to 21.30 s, and s3-shot-3, 21.30 to 23.55 s), OrderPassFilm.tsx draws the tapping hand only while `S.s3.tapGo>0&&S.s3.tapBack<1` (and `payGo>0&&payBack<1`). tapBack is ease5((r3-.74)/.26), so it reaches exactly 1 at the end of s3-event-3, at 15.54+3.51+1.2 = 20.25 s. At that frame the hand rests at its eased `away` point, contact + (300,420)*fs. For menu-tap:a (phone at 520,760, scale 1.5, Chow mein contact at about 547,631, fs 1.3) that point is about (937,1177), on screen. The fingertip, the finger shaft (about 200 px) and the left part of the 1.3x hand then vanish in a single frame, about 1.05 s before the cut. pay-mark:a repeats the construction. Its away point is about (841,1345) at fs 1, and most of the on-screen hand vanishes at the s3-event-4 end, 22.695 s, about 0.85 s before the cut. The guest's order and pay actions, the only human ordering actions in the film, therefore end in a pop instead of the hand leaving frame. B is not affected: B's menu-tap keeps the jointed arm drawn throughout, and B's paid-close away point is about (1239,1579), off frame. Correction, if A were ever repaired: carry the away point fully off frame, or keep the hand drawn through the cut.

story_review.one_viewing_summary: Intended chain from the code at counter level. The storefront door swings shut with its bell, the apron swings on the stand hook, and the desk phone rings unanswered while two tables wait with empty plates and a guest raises a hand. An empty sign frame hangs on the glass. The host panel lights and writes Haniya, and an AI host tag hooks on. A hand lifts the phone over the table code, the brackets lock and the menu opens. A fingertip taps Chow mein and then Pay, which becomes the paid mark. The mark travels into the idle printer, the lamp turns red, and the ticket rises and hangs. Only then a cook pours noodles into the wok as the flame flares. A ledger card headed 'Saving or winning back' takes the $9,650 a month tag and an OWNER COUNT stamp beside a clip that snaps shut on nothing. Coins arc into the jar at the pass under a FOX 26 tag. The rule card's 'include cooks' line lights and is circled, and the restaurant folder's 'Takes no tip credit?' box stays blank under a question mark. A hand raises the phone, hesitates and lowers it beside a customer quote card. The panel takes an order and a slip drops into the printer. The jar ends under owner says and no record shown tags.
story_review.opening_to_ending: It opens on an unattended station that asks who takes the order. It ends with the panel taking the order and the jar under two tags, answering that software takes the order and the tip rests on the owner's word, without inventing an outcome.
story_review.weakest_transition: s8 to s9 (49.4 s). The cut goes from the blank tip-credit box in the folder to a hand hesitating at a table code, so the thread moves from the money limit to ordering friction with no carried object. The close then returns to the jar.
